name: golang-dependency-injection
description: Comprehensive guide for dependency injection (DI) in Golang. Covers why DI matters (testability, loose coupling, separation of concerns, lifecycle management), manual constructor injection, and DI library comparison (google/wire, uber-go/dig, uber-go/fx, samber/do). Use this skill when designing service architecture, setting up dependency injection, refactoring tightly coupled code, managing singletons or service factories, or when the user asks about inversion of control, service containers, or
author: samber
summary_zh: 一份 Go 依赖注入实践指南，适合设计服务架构、解耦代码、提升可测试性及管理服务生命周期。
